mt5_access_note: No direct MT5 Manager/API login available in this environment. Analysis from user-provided MT5 HTML/PDF report only. Full deal-by-deal history requires MT5 terminal export (Statement CSV) or login+password+server.
critical_findings: Win rate 27.7% is far below breakeven for typical RR — only works if avg win >> avg loss
Max consecutive losses = 60 — catastrophic streak risk; system must have hard daily/streak stops
71.6% short trades but short WR only ~21.7% vs long WR ~42.9% — short bias is destructive
Almost half of volume on EURUSD (73 trades) with near-flat netto (+0.05) — overtrading FX with no edge
Best PF symbols cluster on Boom/Crash/DSI/XAU/BTC — aligns with our HQ focus instruments
100% manual — no robot discipline; emotional streak continuation likely drove the 60-loss run
Profit factor 1.08 is barely positive; one bad cluster wipes the year
Recovery factor 0.17 is very weak — slow recovery from DD
training_implications: BAN pure short-bias without HTF confirmation — shorts underperformed badly
Prefer instruments with positive netto in report: Vol10, Vol75, DSI10, and our ready list DSI20/30, R_25, 1HZ*
Enforce max consecutive losses gate (e.g. pause after 3–4 losses)
Reduce FX EURUSD-style overtrading; focus synthetic + metal where PF was higher
Require R:R >= 2 and WR path-aware >= 55% before any micro live
Average hold ~7h suggests swing not scalping — match our 1H/4H bias + 5m sniper design

new_strategies.name: HTF Trend Pullback Long
new_strategies.rules: 1H/4H/8H BUY bias; enter only on 5m/15m pullback (RSI<=45 or dip into EMA); SL 1.2 ATR; TP 2.4 ATR; no short leg
new_strategies.why: MT5 long WR ~43% vs short ~22%; report shorts destroyed expectancy

new_strategies.name: HTF Down + Extension Short
new_strategies.rules: HTF SELL + 5m RSI>=60 + mom3<=-0.12%; pullback rally into resistance; max 1 short per symbol per session
new_strategies.why: Allow shorts only when extended — not default short bias like the 71% short account

new_strategies.name: 3-Loss Pause
new_strategies.rules: After 3 consecutive losses on any symbol or account: pause all new entries 4 hours; after 5: pause until next UTC day
new_strategies.why: Account had max 60 consecutive losses — must never allow that again

new_strategies.name: DSI + Vol Priority
new_strategies.rules: Only signal on elite ready list + Boom/Crash when validated; skip EURUSD unless OOS WR>=60% on our stack
new_strategies.why: Report PF clustered on Vol/DSI/Boom/XAU not FX spam
